title: On-This-Day Memory Resurfacing
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifelog:moment
| eval this_day=strftime(_time,"%m-%d"), today=strftime(now(),"%m-%d")
| where this_day=today AND _time<relative_time(now(),"-1y@d")
| table _time title place
| sort - _time
description: Resurfaces moments you logged on this calendar date in previous years, like a personal on-this-day feed.
value: Rediscovering old moments brings unexpected joy and stitches the years of your life together.
implementation: Ingest logged moments into `index=personal`; surface entries from the same date in past years.
visualization: Table of past moments from today's date.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back things that happened on this very day in past years, a lovely surprise of old memories.
